text:
Business Partner End Of Purpose (EoP) Check
Business Partner End Of Purpose (EoP) Check
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA) checks whether data of business partners
with the contract partner role (
MKK
) exists and
whether it is still relevant for business activities or can be blocked.
Data Protection and Privacy: Process and Terminology
For more information, see the
“Data Protection and Privacy”
section in the
“Security Guide for SAP S/4HANA”
at
http://help.sap.com/s4hana
.

ILM-Based Deletion of Business Partner
Data
(
BUPA_ILM_BF
) and one
of the following industry business functions depending on the industry solution you
are using.

Blocking of Business Partners
The EoP check for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable supports the use of application rule variants.
You use rule variants in the definition of residence rules (for example, for the ILM objects
CA_BUPA
and
FI_FICA
) in audit area
BUPA_DP
to adapt the EoP
check to your business needs.
You maintain rule variants for application
MKK
in Customizing for
Cross-Application
Components
under
Data Protection
Blocking and Unblocking of Data
Business Partner Master Data
Assign Rule Variants and Groups for the Business Partner EoP Check
.
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable determines rule variants for company code and application object from posting area 1140. So,
you assign a rule variant to the application objects in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable
Technical Settings
Data Protection
Specify Determination of Rule Variants
.
Example
You use a rule variant for a company code representing a legal entity such as a subsidiary in the same or another country
adhering to different legal requirements for retention periods.
Technical Details
EoP Check Implementation
To block business partners with the contract partner role
(
MKK
):
Check whether business partner data is still relevant for business activities using the mass activity
Check Whether Business
Partner Data Can Be Blocked
(transaction
FPDPR1
in the SAP menu
under
Periodic Processing
For Data Protection
).
Note
The audit area
BUPA_DP
must be productive for the ILM object
CA_BUPA
and the policy category
Residence Rules
(transaction
ILMARA
).
If the check finds that business partner data is no longer required, the
program derives the appropriate rule variant from Customizing.
The program calculates the end of residence time (representing the EoP)
based on the residence periods maintained for the ILM object
CA_BUPA
that is active for
the audit area
BUPA_DP
for the
application
MKK
and the
existing rule variants.
This information is made available to the blocking transaction
Block Master Data (Business Partner)
(
BUPA_PRE_EOP
).
Block business partner data no longer required by business activities using transaction
Block Master Data (Business
Partner)
(
BUPA_PRE_EOP
).
For more information, see chapter
Blocking and Unblocking of Business Partners
.
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable uses the following tables:
Tables Used to Store Data Relevant for Blocking
Technical Name of Table
Use
DFKKDPR_BP
DFKKDPR_BP_SORT
These transparent tables store the start of retention time (SoRT) as calculated by the
check program (transaction
FPDPR1
).
The information in these tables is processed by the blocking
program.
DFKKDPR_BP_ROLE
This database table is an index table for documents with business partners with more
than one role, for example, contract partner and alternative
payer.
DFKKDPR_BP_ASORT
This database table stores archiving information so the check (transaction
FPDPR1
) does
not have to access the archive.
Initial Load Reports
The end of purpose check does not consider business partner data that existed in your system
before you implemented the check, that is, before you activated the appropriate
business functions mentioned above. To include this data into the check, you use
the following initial load reports to populate the appropriate tables:
Report Name
Use
To Be Used When
Affected Data
RFKKDPR_BP_INIT
Use this report after you have activated the appropriate
industry business function to insert existing business
partners into the transparent table
DFKKDPR_BP
.
You use this report only once.
RFKKDPR_BP_ROLE_FKKOP_INIT
Use this report after you have activated the appropriate
industry business function to populate the database
table
DFKKDPR_BP_ROLE
with existing documents.
You use this report only once.
RFKKDPR_BP_ROLE_ORDERPOS_INIT
Use this report after you have activated the appropriate
industry business function to populate the database
table
DFKKDPR_BP_ROLE
with existing requests.
You use this report only once.
Note
If you do not use requests, you do not have to execute
the report.
RFKKDPR_BP_ROLE_P2P_INIT
Use this report after you have activated the appropriate
industry business function to populate the database
table
DFKKDPR_BP_ROLE
with existing promises to pays.
You use this report only once.
Note
If you do not use promises to pay, you do not have to
execute the report.
RFKKDPR_MIG
Use this report after you have activated the appropriate
industry business function to populate the database
table
DFKKDPR_BP_ASORT
with data that has been archived before you activated
the business function.
For each archive file you use this report only once.
Note
If you have not archived any data yet, you do not have
to execute the report.
RFSCDDPR_BP_ROLE_VVSCPOS_INIT
Use this report after you have activated the appropriate
industry business function to populate the database
table
DFKKDPR_BP_ROLE
for existing payment plan items.
Note
Use this report only if you are using Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable as
part of SAP for Insurance.
You use this report only once.
Handling of Archived Data
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable collects information related to the start of
retention of business partners during archiving runs in the
DFKKDPR_BP_ASORT
database
table.
The initial load report
RFKKDPR_MIG
populates the
DFKKDPR_BP_ASORT
table in the same
way as the archiving run would.
To determine whether archived business partner data is still relevant for business
activities, the check program (transaction
FPDPR1
) only analyzes the
DFKKDPR_BP_ASORT
database table.
The program does not accesses archiving files or the archive information
system.
